headline: Stocks are focused on the 2 PM FOMC minutes after hot October CPI revived Fed hike talk, with Nvidia's post-close results and Thursday's Anthropic IPO testing the AI trade.
rates: Hot October inflation has pushed bond yields higher and put a possible December Fed hike on the table.
fed: Minutes of the Oct 27-28 meeting (two dissents favoring a hike) come out Wednesday at 2 PM ET, and Governor Cook speaks Friday.
oil: Oil has slid to the low $90s Brent on hopes for a US-Iran deal, though Iran says the Strait of Hormuz stays closed until its conditions are met.
geo: US-Iran talks over the war and Hormuz, plus Ukraine-Russia talks, remain the main geopolitical swing factors.

events.name: Anthropic IPO (ANT) expected to begin trading
